testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a sketch line style change: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:172:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a sketch line style change ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a dimensioned sketch is nested under an extrusion in the MCAD Software ✔ And the sketch line type is Default ✔ When the user opens Properties from the sketch row context menu ✔ Then the geometry properties dialog shows line color, line type and line weight controls ✔ And the line type field displays Default ✔ And Apply is disabled ✔ When the user chooses Dashed as the line type ✔ Then the line type field displays Dashed and Apply is enabled ✔ When the user clicks Cancel and reopens the sketch properties ✔ Then the line type field displays Default ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the properties dialog closes
